Priya Patel: Quick sync — we need to nail launch criteria for the Data Governance bundle (audit export + key rotation controls) before next sprint planning.
Marco Ruiz: For MVP, can we scope to 90-day export + basic BYOK via KMS only? that gets most customers unblocked.
Lina Chen: 90 days + BYOK is fine from security but we need clarity on key rotation workflow. will the platform rotate or customer-managed rotation?
Priya Patel: Customer-managed rotation only for v1; platform rotation + escrow is v2. we need that in docs so sales doesn't promise more.
Jamal Ortiz: Customers asking for export formats: CSV + JSONL OK? And are we including schema mapping for events?
Maya Singh: JSONL with event schema v1 is required. CSV can be a later add-on. put schema link in the doc: https://internal.redwood/schemas/audit-events
Marco Ruiz: Technical constraints: export service will need pagination and rate limits; propose async job + S3 presigned URL delivery. SLA: 48h max for large exports.
Lina Chen: Also require an immutable audit log flag in metadata and retention TTL config per org. compliance teams insist on immutable writes.
Priya Patel: Decision: MVP = audit export (JSONL v1), 90-day retention default, org-level retention override up to 365 days, BYOK via KMS (customer-managed rotation), presigned S3 export jobs, export SLA 48h. Anything blocking?
Marco Ruiz: Blocker: storage retention + deletion flow needs legal sign-off for override >90 days. can Legal confirm by EOD?
Maya Singh: I'll coordinate with Legal. FYI SOC2 item mapping here: https://internal.redwood/compliance/soc2-map — we should reference controls for audit exports.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll draft the user-facing docs and quickstart for solutions team. ETA: two working days.
deploy-bot: New spec doc created: /internal/specs/data-governance-mvp.md :thumbsup:
Priya Patel: Great. Action items: Marco -> infra design doc by Thu, Jamal -> docs 2d, Maya -> legal confirmation, Lina -> threat model update. We'll circle back Fri AM.
Marco Ruiz: Noted. tagging @Owen for budget implications on S3 costs.
Owen Blake: S3 costs OK within forecast but we should add telemetry to measure export sizes. :+1:
Priya Patel: Thanks everyone — closing thread. :white_check_mark:
